thread:
Jason: Heads-up — proposing we officially sunset API v1 on 2026-05-01. Reason: maintenance burden + most traffic migrated to v2. Plan below, please react with concerns or blockers. :wave:

Priya: Quick Q — do we have traffic numbers and a suggested grace period for Dedicated/Private tenants? Some customers still pinned to v1.

Jason: Traffic: ~5% of total calls (mostly older SDKs). Proposal: soft-deprecate now (banner + telemetry), automatic 302-style routing for compatible calls for 30d, then hard stop with an escape hatch for Dedicated/Private for extra 90d if needed.

Anita: For Private deployments we can't change runtime behaviour remotely. We'll need an opt-in compatibility-mode package or a backported shim. Also SDKs: we should bump client libs with warnings and an easy migration guide.

Priya: Ok — can we offer a per-tenant flag so platform teams can opt out of the redirect? Some infra teams require explicit consent before routing changes.

Jason: Yes — plan includes a tenant-level override `compat.v1.allow_redirect` default=false for Dedicated/Private. Hosted accounts: we will auto-redirect if Accept header indicates v1 and request is compatible.

Anita: How do we decide "compatible"? v1 allowed older prompt param names and returned top-level `choices`. v2 has structured `outputs`. We should do a whitelist of endpoints + schemas we can safely transform.

Jason: Agree. Compatibility rules will live in our routing policy service. Rough transform: map `choices[0].text` -> `outputs[0].content` and preserve `usage` mapping. Any mismatches get 409 with migration guidance.

Priya: Quotas — do v1 calls count against the same token quota? Billing is sensitive.

Jason: We'll normalize on ingest: tokens are tokens. However we'll emit `api.client_version` and `api.request_version` in telemetry so billing/ops can split if needed. No change to customer-facing quota dashboards for now.

Anita: For SDKs, add deprecated warnings on init and a runtime check that suggests `Accept: application/vnd.redwood.v2+json` or `X-Redwood-Api-Version: v2`. Provide a code snippet for migration.

Jason: Snippet for routing (internal):
```
if header.X-Redwood-Api-Version == "v1":
  if tenant.allow_redirect:
    route = translate_to_v2_and_proxy(req)
  else:
    reply = deprecation_banner_and_401(req)
else:
  route = v2_handler(req)
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot created config draft `v1-sunset-rollout` (PR #4821) — includes routing policy + telemetry fields.

ConsoleUX: We'll add a top-of-console banner for all org admins (hosted) with a per-org migration checklist and a one-click "Request extended v1 support" that files a ticket to sales/CS. Also adding a per-route status card showing %v1 traffic and estimated migration effort.

Priya: Nice. Who owns the migration docs and the customer comms timeline? We should coordinate with CS/marketing.

Jason: Owners: Routing & runtime: Anita, Telemetry & billing signals: Priya, Console banners & UX: ConsoleUX. Docs + SDKs: Anita + DevEx. I'll draft comms and share a one-pager by EOD tomorrow.

Anita: Action: I'll start a compatibility whitelist PR and a lightweight shim for on-prem. ETA: 2 weeks for initial PR.

Priya: I'll pull usage slices and flag high-usage tenants that need human outreach. ETA: 3 days.

Jason: Thanks. If no major objections, I'll post the deprecation notice draft to #announcements tomorrow and open the rollout epic. :thumbsup:

ConsoleUX: Adding UI mock for the banner/one-click flow to the rollout epic now.

Priya: +1 from me, but please ensure dedicated contracts that mention "v1 API" are handled by Sales before hard stop.

Jason: Noted — will loop in Sales and Legal on the epic.

Anita: One more: let's emit a metric `api.version_mismatch` for 409s so we can monitor migration friction.

Jason: Good call. Adding that to telemetry checklist.
